description: This file defines a Go package 'types' that implements a wrapper for protobuf messages, enabling conversion, comparison, and reflection-based access to protobuf objects within the CEL (Common Expression Language) framework.

classes.name: protoObj
classes.description: A wrapper for protobuf messages that supports conversion, comparison, and reflection.

classes.name: protoObjField
classes.description: Represents a protobuf message field descriptor and its value.

methods.name: NewObject
methods.description: Creates a new protoObj instance from a protobuf message, handling type description and value.

methods.name: ConvertToNative
methods.description: Converts the protoObj to a native Go type based on reflect.Type.

methods.name: ConvertToType
methods.description: Converts the protoObj to a specified CEL type.

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Checks equality between this protoObj and another ref.Val.

methods.name: IsSet
methods.description: Checks if a specific field in the protobuf message is set.

methods.name: IsZeroValue
methods.description: Determines if the protobuf message is empty or zero.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a field value from the protobuf message by name.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the CEL type of the protoObj.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats the protobuf message into a string representation.
